subject: fiddlehead-cricket character
art_direction: 蕨类嫩卷成为小蟋蟀的两侧肩环，纤维身与宽叶后腿，蓝绿黄三色平面跳跃感。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Combine a cricket-like character with two large fiddlehead fern curls forming circular shoulder shapes. Its body is a short fibrous seed form, and the rear legs are broad folded leaves rather than thin insect limbs. Lean it forward with one leg tucked up, as if deciding whether to hop. Give it a tiny eager face beneath short curved antennae. Use teal, muted yellow, and indigo screenprinted collage shapes on cream paper. Keep the fern curls open and the silhouette readable, avoiding realistic joint detail, motion lines, or a busy meadow. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
